neo.ghi_chu: Do bang chinh ban khai nay ngay 06/09, sau khi ban khai nhap sot hai thu muc route. file = so .tsx tren dia trong sau thu muc; file_quet = con lai sau khi tru sau file hoan; chuoi = ung vien truoc khi tru mien tru, tach thanh van_ban + thuoc_tinh. Lech la thoat ma 2 kem diff ten file.
